about: breakout: next season a regular at or over the quality bar for the first time (PFN score z shrunk to replacement by workload >= 0.317, the 77.5th percentile of regulars); players already at the bar this season or an earlier one are left out; base 2026; odds = logistic on shrunk z, workload, position + class curve, projection gap (each passes leave-one-season-out 2019-2026; final t 6.03, 7/7 seasons). OPP/G = attempts (QB), carries + catches (RB), targets (WR, TE), snaps (EDGE, DT, LB) a game; seniors and workloads below the fit's range left out. no workload tiers: the change in workload did not predict next-season efficiency out of sample (t 0.35, 3/7 seasons on workloads up 25%+)
